synopsis: The glossary places EN 50128 within the European railway standards covering reliability and safety management, software and electronic signaling [f15359]. Chapter 10 identifies EN 50716:2023 as its successor, while the glossary also calls that successor the current railway software standard [f7718, f15360]. However, both locations explicitly list EN 50128 and related railway standards as not verified in this research [f7716, f15361]. For planning off-road automatic braking validation, the booklet therefore leaves their relevance, risk scaling, physical-data validation, validity envelopes, transfer rules and remaining physical-evidence requirements unverified [f8155].

relations.note: Both list the same four railway standards as unverified.
Both identify EN 50716:2023 as EN 50128's successor.
Specifies unverified validation dimensions and relevance to off-road automatic braking.
Details what was not verified for the listed railway standards.
